title: Highly recommended
text: Our tour guide Steffano was wonderful. He took us to places we would not have known about on our own. He gave us the history of each place and what we were eating. They were at proper sit down places and were served proper portion sizes with quality drinks and food. We were full by the end. We would highly recommend this tour
author: 624yvettem

title: Great tour with a phenomenal guide!
text: My wife and I wound up having a personally guided tour as the other guest were no-shows. The guide (29 years old) was a Barcelona native that knew the city very well. His English was excellent. My wife and I had a great couple of hours exploring some less touristy parts of Barcelona. I would certainly look at booking this service again for Barcelona or other cities.
author: E7899UHdavidm

title: This is a really special tour!!
text: This is a fabulous tour!  Not your usual tourist trap thing.  Our guide, Juan, was amazing!!  He shared all kinds of cultural insights as well as daily life schedules and habits of a typical person living in Barcelona.  Very different from where we live!!  It was fascinating!  Juan took us to little out of the way places to eat (where the locals eat!).  Juan was informative, helpful, engaging, and insightful.  It was a fabulous tour!!
author: cindyrichardson

title: Uncommon with Juan was great!!!
text: We had an amazing time with Juan! He was so knowledgeable and friendly and really gave us an amazing experience!
author: P8700LSjudyw

title: Incredible time with Uncommon Barcelona
text: Incredible time! Leaned so much and our tour guide Juan was so smart and friendly. Highly recommend!
author: AnnaC314

text: My bf and I loved this tour. It was a great way to discover the real Barcelona away from the crowds. Juan was a fantastic guide.... full of great stories. The social project we visited was amazing, and the staff were incredibly welcoming and good vibes. One of the highlights of our trip!
author: giselasR8456UK

title: Loved it!
text: I really enjoyed the tour. It felt very authentic and quite different from the usual experience. I even got to see houses right in the city! It was a relaxed and fun tour away from the crowds. The guide was fantastic, and the itinerary was great. I would never have ended up in that part of Barcelona on my own. Loved it!
author: natalial387

title: Great Tour!
text: Great tour! The markets were really cool, and having a tapa and a drink in such a local spot was a nice touch. The area was beautiful and surprisingly quiet. A very enjoyable experience!
author: lililM2615HD

title: DREAM TRIP
text:
I joined this tour with my girlfriend during our trip to Barcelona, and it was easily one of the best experiences we had. It was a great way to explore parts of the city beyond the usual tourist spots and get a real feel for local life.
Our guide, Juan, was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the tour engaging from start to finish. If you're looking to experience a more authentic side of Barcelona, I definitely recommend this tour.
